Invia messaggi con suffisso casuale: Send messages with a random suffix
Ferma gli invii nella chat corrente: Stop sending in the current chat
Elenca persone e gruppi osservati: List followed people and monitored groups
Analizza foto, video o URL: Analyse a photo, video or URL
Invia nota nella chat: Send a note to the chat
Attiva risposte AFK nelle chat private: Enable AFK replies in private chats
Disattiva AFK e mostra durata: Disable AFK and show its duration
Numero, paese, operatore e formati: Phone number, country, carrier and formats
Autore visibile dell'inoltro: Visible author of a forwarded message
Rileva il tipo e avvia la ricerca: Detect the type and start a search
Backup locali di preferenze e note: Local backups of preferences and notes
Solo gruppi; mostra ID, username e membr: Groups only; show ID, username and members.
@username, ID o risposta; mostra dati pu: @username, ID or reply; show public information.
Testo con spazi; gli ultimi due valori s: Text may contain spaces; the last two values are the count (1–100) and interval (0–3600 seconds, including decimals). Example: >spam hello everyone 5 0. Each message ends with | and 5 random characters. One sequence per chat, in the same topic; messages are retained. Stops if Telegram requests a pause or rejects a message.
Ferma la sequenza nella chat corrente. G: Stop the sequence in the current chat. Sending does not resume after a restart.
on/off attiva o ferma. sceglie fino a 3: on/off enables or stops reactions. Choose up to 3 emoji separated by spaces; count 1|2|3 uses the first N in the list.
Rispondi a un messaggio oppure indica @u: Reply to a message or enter @username or an ID. Shows an 8=D drawing with 1 to 13 = symbols.
Reply to a message or enter @username or an ID. Shows two (.) (.) drawings with 0 to 13 spaces on either side of each dot. Spaces are preserved.
Scegli sasso, carta o forbici; Melixsa e: Choose sasso, carta or forbici; Melixsa picks its move and shows the result. Also accepts rock, paper and scissors.
Lettere A-Z, cifre e punteggiatura stand: A–Z letters, digits and standard punctuation. Separate letters with spaces and words with /. Accepts text or a reply. Accents and emoji produce an error rather than being discarded.
Punti e trattini; separa le lettere con: Dots and dashes; separate letters with spaces and words with /. Returns uppercase text. Accepts an argument or a reply.
Crea un link Google con il testo corrett: Create a Google link with correctly encoded text. Makes no web requests. Accepts an argument or a reply.
Indica il linguaggio seguito dal codice,: Enter the language followed by code, or reply to code with codeblock python. Uses Telegram PRE entities, preserving markup and literal symbols. The code is not executed.
Valida JSON e lo formatta con rientro di: Validate JSON and format it with two-space indentation in a Telegram block. Accepts an argument or a reply; maximum 1500 input characters and 4000 UTF-16 output units.
Attiva AFK con messaggio opzionale e GIF: Enable AFK with an optional message and GIF. Private chats only, one reply per person every 6 hours. Repeating afk changes the message and resets the duration and recipients. Disabled after a restart.
Disattiva AFK e mostra la durata dell'as: Disable AFK and show the time away. Alias: unafk. Normal outgoing messages do not disable AFK.
Mostra stato, durata, messaggio e ultimo: Show AFK status, duration, message and latest problem.
@username, ID o risposta; segue nei grup: @username, ID or reply; follow in visible groups.
Mostra persone seguite con stalk e grupp: Show people followed with stalk and groups monitored with surveillance: names, usernames and IDs. Also works in private chats and Saved Messages. Inaccessible entries remain listed by ID.
Mostra tutte le persone seguite con stal: Show everyone followed with stalk, including name, username and ID.
Mostra tutti i gruppi con surveillance a: Show all groups with surveillance enabled, including title, username and ID.
Cerca per nome, alias, categoria e descr: Search by name, alias, category and description. Example: search morse. An optional final number selects the page. Shows only authorised commands and respects minimal-mode.
Elenco alfabetico con sintassi e descriz: Alphabetical list with syntax and descriptions, split into pages. allcmds 2 opens page two. Shows only authorised commands and respects minimal-mode.
Elenca ricerche estese attive e ultime c: List active extended searches and the latest five completed ones, with ID, status, elapsed time and queue position. The owner sees all; others see their own searches in the current chat. Up to 10 queued operations, one at a time. Searches do not resume after a restart.
Annulla una ricerca estesa in coda o in: Cancel a queued or running extended search using its osintjobs ID. The owner can stop any search; others can stop their own in the current chat. Messages already sent remain in the chat.
Rispondi a una foto, video o URL del med: Reply to a photo, video or media URL
MX, Gravatar pubblico, registrazioni ril: MX, public Gravatar, registrations detected by holehe and known XposedOrNot breaches. No passwords are returned.
Scansione asincrona del dataset WhatsMyN: Asynchronous search of the WhatsMyName dataset using page indicators. False positives are possible; full TXT report.
WHOIS, DNS, SPF/DMARC e sottodomini pubb: WHOIS, DNS, SPF/DMARC and subdomains published in certificates, with links for further information.
Solo IP pubblici: geolocalizzazione appr: Public IPs only: approximate location and data already indexed by Shodan InternetDB. No active port scanning.
Tipi: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME. Prede: Types: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME. Default: A.
Mostra date, stato e nameserver pubblici: Show public dates, status and nameservers.
Mostra il certificato TLS pubblico sulla: Show the public TLS certificate on port 443.
Legge nomi dai certificati pubblici di c: Read names from public certificates on crt.sh.
Riepiloga DNS e sottodomini da fonti pub: Summarise DNS and subdomains from public sources.
on cerca su LRCLIB e invia le righe sinc: on searches LRCLIB and sends synced lines to the current chat; off stops them everywhere. Without an argument, shows status. One active chat; does not resume after a restart.
Brano, artista, album, stato, tempo e vo: Track, artist, album, status, playback time and volume of the selected SoundCloud player.
Riprende il brano nella scheda SoundClou: Resume playback in the SoundCloud tab connected through WebNowPlaying.
Mette in pausa il brano nella scheda Sou: Pause playback in the connected SoundCloud tab.
Alterna play e pausa nella scheda SoundC: Toggle play and pause in the connected SoundCloud tab.
Passa al prossimo brano della coda Sound: Skip to the next track in the SoundCloud queue, if available.
Passa al brano precedente della coda Sou: Skip to the previous track in the SoundCloud queue, if available.
Senza valore mostra il volume; con un in: Without a value, show the volume; enter an integer from 0 to 100 to change it.
Accetta secondi, mm:ss o hh:mm:ss entro: Accepts seconds, mm:ss or hh:mm:ss within the track’s duration.
off disattiva, all ripete la coda, one r: off disables repeat, all repeats the queue, one repeats the track.
on attiva, off disattiva; senza argoment: on enables it, off disables it; without an argument, toggle the state.
on aggiunge il like, off lo rimuove; sen: on likes the track, off removes the like; without an argument, toggle it. Requires a SoundCloud login.
Elenca solo i player SoundCloud; * indic: List only SoundCloud players; * marks the controlled tab.
Sceglie un ID da scplayers; auto segue i: Choose an ID from scplayers; auto follows the most active SoundCloud player. Returns to automatic selection if the tab closes.
Mostra porta e istruzioni per il Custom: Show the port and instructions for the WebNowPlaying Custom Adapter on the same PC as the selfbot.
Diagnostica locale senza richieste ai se: Local diagnostics without external service requests: Telegram, configuration, backups, logs, searches, SoundCloud, lyrics, AFK, anti-login and recent errors. Owner only. Credentials are not shown.
on/off abilita avvisi generici nei Messa: on/off enables generic alerts in Saved Messages, at most once per minute. Initially off. Alerts contain neither searched text nor error contents.
Senza argomenti mostra i limiti. size <b: Without arguments, show limits. size <bytes> (65536–1000000000), backups <count> (1–100), days <days> (0–3650). days 0 disables expiry for closed archives. Limits also apply to existing archives; pending recovery files are excluded.
add/remove autorizza utenti; allow/block: add/remove authorises users; allow/block manages commands and categories. Initially excludes settings, abuse, soundcloud and misc, with help included. Settings and abuse remain owner-only. Menus and help show only enabled categories and commands. Permissions survive restarts.
Show the prefix, reply timer and monitoring status.
Timer delle risposte: 0 disattiva; massi: Reply timer: 0 disables it; maximum 3600 seconds. Commands are deleted immediately.
Apri una categoria o un comando. I menu: Open a category or command. Long menus are split into pages of up to 12 entries. Examples: help text 2 or text 2. Page number and previous/next commands appear at the bottom. Aliases: h, ?.
Impostazioni della console salvate per i: Console settings survive restarts. NO_COLOR disables colours.
Pulisce la console sul computer dove gir: Clear the console on the computer running Melixsa. No arguments required.
Senza argomento mostra lo stato. on most: Without an argument, show status. on shows Telegram connections, tasks and WebNowPlaying details; off hides them. Initially off; saved across restarts.
Invalidazione dei codici ricevuti da Tel: Invalidate codes received from Telegram and check new sessions every 30 seconds. on/off/status; aliases enable/disable. Sessions present at startup are authorised. Initially on; setting is saved. May also block your own new devices.
on mostra nei menu solo comandi e sintas: on shows only command names and syntax in menus, without » or explanations; off restores details. Without an argument, show status. Initially off; saved across restarts.
Ultimi 10 comandi terminati; 1-50 scegli: The latest 10 completed commands; 1–50 chooses how many to show, clear empties the list. Names, time, result and duration only, without arguments or recipients. Kept in memory and cleared on restart. Owner only.
create [nome], view <nome>, restore <nom: create [name], view <name>, restore <name> settings|notes, delete <name>; backups lists copies. Up to 30 local copies in data/backups/. An automatic copy is saved before restoring. Excludes credentials, sessions, access permissions, monitoring and anti-login. Owner only.
List local backups in data/backups/. Use backup to create, inspect, restore and delete them. No files are sent to chat. Owner only.
